facts.text: Hotel Le Fontanelle is a manor house deep in the heart of Chianti.
facts.excerpt: offering discreet elegance deep in the heart of Chianti. A manor house where hospitality comes naturally

facts.text: The hotel caters to couples, families, groups of colleagues and friends.
facts.excerpt: ready to cater to couples, families, groups of colleagues and friends.

facts.text: The estate transformed old farmhouses into intimate, modern spaces.
facts.excerpt: It has come natural therefore to transform old farmhouses into intimate, modern spaces that will make you feel at home.

facts.text: Guests have free use of a panoramic swimming pool, mountain bikes, petanque, a heated indoor swimming pool, sauna, Turkish bath, Jacuzzi and relaxing area.
facts.excerpt: For guest free use: panoramic swimming pool, mountain bikes, pétanque, heated indoor swimming pool, sauna, turkish bath, Jacuzzi and relaxing area.

facts.text: The Health Club includes an indoor heated pool, relaxation area, fitness room, sauna, Turkish bath, jacuzzi and private massage room, with free access reserved for Hotel Le Fontanelle guests.
facts.excerpt: The Health Club includes an indoor heated pool, relaxation area, fitness room, sauna, Turkish bath, jacuzzi and private massage room. Access is free and reserved for guests at Hotel Le Fontanelle.

facts.text: Classic Rooms have terracotta floors and oak-beamed ceilings.
facts.excerpt: Romantic residences with terracotta floors and oak-beamed ceilings.

facts.text: Prestige Rooms have a small private garden.
facts.excerpt: Rooms with a small private garden where guests can submerge themselves fully in the magic of the estate.

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms have a private lounge area and views.
facts.excerpt: Tastefully decorated rooms with a private lounge area, evocative views and refined furnishings.

facts.text: Junior Suites are surrounded by vineyards and olive groves of the Sienese countryside.
facts.excerpt: Serene and comfortable rooms surrounded by vineyards and olive groves of the Sienese countryside.

facts.text: Suites have a living room and a large private garden.
facts.excerpt: Luxury suites with living room and large private garden.

facts.text: La Colonna restaurant reinterprets Italian cuisine, with windows all around the restaurant offering views.
facts.excerpt: La Colonna reinterprets Italian cuisine with innovative pairings which remain respectful to its history. The windows all around the restaurant offer a breathtaking view.

facts.text: Activities include hot air balloon flights, horseback riding, petanque, Vespa outings, e-bike rides and picnics.
Guests can visit the Vallepicciola winery of the Bolfo family, with a biodiverse vineyard, woods, meadow and small lake.
facts.excerpt:
Come and discover the Bolfo family winery.
Explore the estate’s biodiverse vineyard, woods, meadow, and small lake.

facts.text: Wine tours visit the vineyards and the barrel room of the modern Vallepicciola cellar.
facts.excerpt: Knowing a wine means seeing the vineyards from which it is born and the barrel room where it is refined and where it rests. Let yourself be guided to discover our modern cellar nestled in the Tuscan hills.

facts.text: Hotel Le Fontanelle shares its estate with a sister hotel, The Club House.
facts.excerpt: Discover our two hotels, The Club House and Hotel Le Fontanelle
